title: "TGCA Download"
author: "Kripa Anand"
date: "2026-10-21"
output: html_document
---
```{r}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
```


```{r}
query.exp <- GDCquery(
    project = "TCGA-BRCA", 
    data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
    data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification", 
    workflow.type = "STAR - Counts",
    sample.type = c("Primary Tumor")
)
```


```{r}
GDCdownload(
    query = query.exp,
    files.per.chunk = 100)
```

```{r}
#if data is already downloaded from GDC skip download and run 

brca.data <- GDCprepare(query.exp, directory = "GDCdata")
```


```{r}

#if downloading for the first time run 

brca.data <- GDCprepare(query.exp)

```

```{r}
sample.info <- SummarizedExperiment::colData(brca.data)
#tells the types of data downloaded from TCGA as column names
#looking to isolate the PAM50 subtype - Luminal A (ER+/HER-)
#"paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50" gives information on the type- filter by this 
```


```{r}
#subset the data by cancer subtype. will throw error is NAs not handled

brca_lumA <- brca.data[,brca.data$paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50 == "LumA" & !is.na(brca.data$paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50)]

```

```{r}
#creates a matrix containing the gene id and counts from the GDC data

brca_matrix <- assay(brca_lumA, "fpkm_unstrand")
```

```{r}

#if raw counts is preferred can use instead 
brca_matrix2 <- assay(brca_lumA, "stranded_first")
```

```{r}
#export the assay data to a CSV file
#just in case
brca_fpkm <- as.data.frame(brca_matrix2)
write.csv(brca_fpkm, "brca_counts.csv")
```

```{r}
query.clinic <- GDCquery_clinic(project = "TCGA-BRCA",
                                type = "clinical",
                                save.csv = FALSE)
```

```{r}
clinical_data <- as.data.frame(query.clinic)
```

```{r}
clinical_data <- clinical_data[,c(2,4,16,44,53,55)]
```

```{r}
write.csv(clinical_data,"clinical_data.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```
